description:
Consumables are usually medical aid/ equipment that have to be discarded after use & the cost incurred from the consumables is directly billed to the patient (if not covered in the health insurance policy.

In this video, we will understand what all is Included in Consumable / Non- payables & also shared my opinion on Whether you should choose for a consumable rider or not.
